paragraphs: Ridecell sells an asset intelligence and orchestration platform for automotive leasing and finance companies and the clients those companies serve. The page says the platform unifies data from 100+ siloed systems that never talk.

Five intelligence modules cover client experience, invoice integrity, supplier performance, vehicle lifecycle and fleet uptime. Each module is described as acting on fleet data on its own, with decisions ready to execute rather than dashboards to interpret.

A Gen-AI agent named Maya sits on top of the knowledge graph and either takes action or assists a team. Deployment options run from a single-tenant managed cloud in a chosen region to a cloud account run by the customer's own IT team.

quote.text: Agents that monitor, recommend, and decide.
